result: Actual finite-state morphology compilation/lookup demonstrated; native runtime adoption and broad data qualification remain open.
engine_value: A compact compiled relation analyzes and generates noun-class/number and verb tense/person forms from one source.
lexd flag-diacritic compilation avoids expansion: retained source43,480KiB compiler RSS instead of unflagged1GiB address-space exhaustion.
The same relation is inverted for analysis; morphology can feed reviewed phrase slot constraints or build-time attested-form export.
retained_language_gaps: chakula has only a verbal analysis, not the expected food noun
sisomi/hamsomi absent; generator emits sisoma for first-person present negative
hamtasoma returns p3 plural rather than p2 plural
unasoma retains multiple person/noun-class analyses; raw morphology cannot determine sentence meaning
count_limits: Feature-presence counts permit additional conflicting analyses and authored unknown controls. They are not precision, independent human acceptance, or conversation coverage.
decision: Keep optional evidence-backed morphology arm in comparison. Do not replace source phrase matcher, activate Swahili FST globally, infer safe sense selection from POS alone, or introduce shared C++ runtime before comparative value is demonstrated.

sources.role: Pattern-matching capability documented; not exercised in this morphology probe
